input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalt", "damages", late charges/interest and termination-related text return no Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty or early-termination/minimum-fee-on-termination provision. The termination clause (§14) and term clause (§13) require only continued service through the month following notice, with no exit payment; the unsolicited e-mail covenant (§7) imposes no per-message or fixed penalty on Client. This meets the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer). Noted but not flagged: §5(a) contains blank monthly minimum fees for Hosting and Support Services, which are ordinary recurring pricing minimums rather than liquidated damages, and Client remains liable for fees only for services rendered through the termination date.
